text: 472 removed nowrap/hidden-overflow/ellipsis from URL anchors. Current .header-message-url a retains display:inline-block and max-inline-size:80vw, allowing wrapping instead of truncating the link. Preserve the distinction between limiting layout and hiding content. No zoom, keyboard, accessibility-tree, or rendered long-URL test was run.
title: Keep long header links readable within their layout bound
